title: Kokohi Arazu
body:
Syntax: perform kokohi arazu <carried item> as <apparent name>

Description: Change the visible name of a carried item without altering the real item. Change how a carried item looks to other players who examine you; its real identity and properties stay intact. Usable with any chakra nature. Illusion lasts 20 pulses. Unlocks at level 18. Costs 20 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
